claims: Turn off the power supply to the ceiling fan before checking it.
A grinding noise and stiffness usually indicate worn-out ball bearings that need replacement.
You can manually rotate the blades after turning off power to check for resistance.
Hire a local electrician to replace the faulty bearings safely.

claims.text: Stiff or grinding bearings mean taking the fan down and replacing them.
For stiff or worn bearings, you need a technician.
